test_crypten_mpc_functions: test all member functions of the crypten package for secure multi-party computation
test_przs_generators: test that PRZS generators are initialized independently across parties and devices
test_manual_seeds: test that user-supplied seeds replace auto-generated seeds in crypten generators
test_cat_stack: test concatenation and stacking of encrypted tensors across multiple dimensions
test_save_load_cryptensors: test saving and loading of cryptensor shares using torch or custom serialization
